source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Design and interpret a fair natural-indicator test using prepared extracts or indicator papers.
node_labels: Matter: materials, particles, mixtures and change

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Use one drop of sample A and ten drops of sample B; the comparison is fair if the indicator is the same and both final colours are recorded.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Both samples could be identified as acid or base, so the comparison must have been fair.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The two separate experiments are unfair because one uses rose extract and the other uses turmeric paper.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The comparison is unfair because the samples have different starting colours, even though both final indicator colours are clearly readable.

intelligence.enrichment: A fair indicator comparison uses the same prepared indicator, comparable sample amounts, and recorded final colours so differences are due to sample nature rather than procedure. controlled_indicator_procedure -> comparable_observations -> interpretable_result student can list materials like petals and droppers but cannot say why the same procedure is needed

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Acids, bases and salts. The student must decide: Design and interpret a fair natural-indicator test using prepared extracts or indicator papers. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
